steps.name: Effective-Edge Curve
steps.detail: PROFILE LIMBO-19, judged against the RTP-CLAIM band (0.1 pp from the 1.00% edge claim) on the AUDITED RANGE, every 2-dp target from 1.01x to 10000x (the lowest and the highest target settled on production): 0 of the 999900 targets sit more than the band from the claim (no FLAG); inside the band the derived edge differs from the 1.00% claim at 999618 of the 999900 targets, always on the house side, by at most 0.009982 pp (1.009982% at 9989.91x) — printed, not flagged; 282 are priced at exactly 1.00% and 0 carry an edge above 1.01%. EXHAUSTIVE: house edge >= 1.00% asserted in EXACT INTEGERS (floor(9900000000/ci(m)) x ci(m) <= 9900000000, no tolerance) at every one of the 99999900 2-dp values in [1.01x, 1000000x], the formula's whole grid up to the result cap — 0 violations (both population sizes are what their windows imply and what this step pins, 999900 and 99999900). THE EDGE IS NOT FLAT ABOVE 1.00%: edge(ci) = (10000000000 - 9900000000 + (9900000000 mod ci)) / 10000000000, so the excess over 1% is driven by (N mod ci) and grows with ci. Mechanically it is a same-odds/different-payout effect: targets sharing one value of floor(N/ci) share an IDENTICAL win chance but are each paid their own multiplier, so within a group RTP = cr x ci / 10000000000 rises with ci and only the LARGEST member is priced as well as those odds allow; 188997 of the 999900 audited targets (18.902%) are the best-priced member of their group (best-priced does not mean priced at 99.00%). ABOVE THE AUDITED RANGE, arithmetic about the formula only (whether production accepts a target above 10000x is not established, Step 17): the first value whose edge exceeds 1.01% is 10009.10x (1.010001%); the first value beyond the RTP-CLAIM band is 100101.12x (RTP 98.899907%); over the whole grid the worst edge is 1.989999% at 990000.01x, 94389859 of 99999900 values carry an edge above 1.01% and 410 are exactly 1.00%. CAPTURED-TARGET SUB-MEASUREMENT, reported separately and NOT to be read as the curve: across the 102 distinct targets the production capture played, spanning 1.01x..10000x (the ends of the audited range), 0 violations, 0 player-favourable targets; 0 targets at which OUR OWN reference formula returned a non-finite value (none), counted explicitly because every comparison against NaN is false; captured edge spans 1.000000% (at 100x) to 1.007054% (at 8571.56x), stake-weighted mean across the capture 1.000006%; 5 of the 102 captured targets price to EXACTLY 1.00% (e.g. target 2.00 -> win chance 49.5000%, RTP 99.0000%); the flooring can only LOWER the payout, never raise it, which is why 1.00% is a provable floor and why the dispersion above it runs one way only; the ends also satisfy the identity (1.01x, 10000x, 1000000x: ok), max win chance 98.019801% at the 1.01x minimum target; the largest edge on the captured targets is 1.00705356% at 8571.56x, a real difference from 1.00% and not a rounding effect
